lines: A brass seal on a dome door: 'This house belongs to the Veil. The family is on loan.'
You pry the seal off.
A brass seal on a gravestone. Even the dead pay ground rent here.
You pry the seal off.
A brass seal on the well rope. Of course it is.
You pry the seal off.
An IOU stuck in a crack: 'Tobs owes for one shovel. The shovel owes Tobs for forty years.'
You pocket the IOU.
An IOU tied to a lamp: 'Oskin owes for fakes. Fake fakes. The Veil wants real money.'
You pocket the IOU.

seal_empty: Just a nail hole now. The seal is in your bag, being property.
iou_empty: Nothing left here but a smell of ink and regret.

lines: Old Mags: Pawnbroker. Fence. Grandmother of nine, landlady of none, thanks to the Veil.
Old Mags: Every brass seal in this town is a family the Veil owns. Eight of them. Pry them off and bring them to me.
Old Mags: I melt them down into spoons. Very satisfying. Spoons can't foreclose.
Old Mags: All eight! Look at that. Eight families, and not one of them will ever thank you. Typical.
Old Mags: Here, a Bond Seal of my own. Honest brass. Well. Mostly honest.
mags_count.action: set_flag s4_seals_done; give_item rg_bond_seal; trust mags 10

mags_after: Old Mags: Spoon? I have three hundred. Each one a little revenge.

lines: Qadir: Qadir. I steal water. From the Veil, so it's more of a refund.
Qadir: I'm digging a free well behind the domes. Lend me a Spirling with strong claws for a night?
Qadir: The Veil keeps the town's IOUs in the cistern. Five of them hurt the most.
Qadir: Bring me those five and we'll have a little bonfire. Bring marshmallows. Kidding. Bring more IOUs.
Qadir: Five! Watch them curl. Best smell in Solenne, burning debt.
Qadir: And a word, friend: Lusk's strongroom locks from the outside. Wedge the door before you sign anything.
qadir_count.action: set_flag s4_ious_done; set_flag c4_qadir_warned; give_item max_tonic 3; trust qadir 10

qadir_after: Qadir: The town's still poor. But now it's poor on its own account. That's progress.
qadir_betray: Qadir brings your Spirling back at dawn. Its keepsake is gone. 'The well needed a down payment,' he says. 'Sorry. Mostly.'
qadir_reward: Qadir: The well runs! Free water, first in six years. The Veil will be livid. Take this, from the whole street.
qadir_kept: Qadir: Hit rock. Your Spirling's fine, my back isn't. Next time.

lines: Saffi: Veil clerk, third grade. I file things. Sometimes I file them in other people's ears.
Saffi: The cistern's back door is open at the west pipe tonight. Free tip. Believe me?
Saffi: Don't look at me like that. I have quotas.
Saffi: I sold Kaia's deed to Sefa's cousin. And to Sefa. And to Kaia. Business is business.

saffi_betray: At the west pipe the door is open. So are the arms of three Veil guards.
'Saffi says hi,' says one. 'And bills you for the overtime.'
saffi_reward: At the west pipe a crate waits, Veil-stamped and unlocked. Even traitors have off days.
saffi_kept: At the west pipe: a locked door and a cat. The cat looks unimpressed.

lines: Dunya: My husband drove carts for the Veil. Now he drives nothing. They kept the cart.
Dunya: If Kaia gives you a gift for the town, read it first. She wraps knives in ribbon.
Kaia: Oh, it's you. My favourite ruin. No hard feelings, I bill them separately.
Kaia: I want to make amends. Take this deed to Sefa at the well. A gift to the town, from me.
Kaia: Trust is a currency. I just prefer the other kind.
Kaia: Lusk is ruined? Shame. I'll send flowers. Then the invoice for the flowers.

deed_caught: You read the deed. It sells the town well to one K. Oasis-Holder, for one coin, signed by Sefa (forged).
Sefa burns it in the lamp. 'She wanted the well for herself. Not for the Veil. For herself.'
deed_struck: Sefa signs it with a smile, then stops smiling. The well now belongs to one K. Oasis-Holder.
A turnstile goes up by noon. The first ticket has your name on it, as a thank-you.
ledger_deed: Kaia handed you a 'gift' for the town: the deed that sold Ochrewell's well to herself.

lines: Corin: Corin Lusk. Nephew. Heir. Future owner of your shoes, probably.
Corin: Uncle says you're an asset. I say let's see the books. Duel me.
Corin: Down a whole team. Uncle will dock my allowance. Again.
Corin: Meet me in the cistern. I'll have better Spirlings. Bought, obviously.
Corin: Told you. New team, fresh off the auction block. Smells like money.
Corin: Hm. Money doesn't fight. Noted. In red.
Corin: Uncle's waiting in the strongroom once the sun moves. Don't sign anything he hands you. Or do. I'd inherit sooner.

corin_lose: Corin: Put it on your tab. Interest starts yesterday.

lines: Corin: The Veil's mine now. Uncle's in the books as a write-off. Thanks for that.
Corin: One last duel. Winner keeps the town's goodwill. Loser keeps the Veil.
Corin: Fine. I'll sell the Veil to the town for one coin. Kaia taught me that one.
Corin: Here's Uncle's private ledger. Every name he ever bought. Burn it or blackmail with it, I don't judge.
Corin: I'm in water reform now. Same water, nicer brochures.

corin_after_cold: Corin: Don't. I'm still deciding if you're a friend or a cost.
ledger_nephew: Corin Lusk sold his uncle's private ledger to you after losing to you. Family is the oldest market.

lines: Corin: Well, well. The person who bankrupted my uncle. I should send you a fruit basket.

corin_bet_betray: Corin: The water board? Dissolved. Your coins? Dissolved with it. Guaranteed, I said. I never said for whom.
corin_bet_reward: Corin: The board paid out. Here's your share, and mine. Don't tell Uncle I'm capable of decency.
corin_bet_kept: Corin: Broke even. Your stake, back. That's the most honest thing a Lusk has ever done.

lines: Undertaker Bex: The Veil prepaid three graves. No names. Lovely tips, though.
Undertaker Bex: Find out who they're for? I hate digging for strangers. I like to know who to haunt.
Undertaker Bex: Any names yet? The Veil keeps its orders in the cistern's lowest room.
Undertaker Bex: Kaia, Qadir and... you? Ha! I'll put you in the shady one. You're welcome.
Undertaker Bex: Tell you what. Beat Lusk, and we fill all three with sand and a rude headstone each.
Undertaker Bex: Three rude headstones. 'Here lies nobody. Paid in full.' My best work.
Undertaker Bex: Have the Veil's tip money. It's cursed, but it spends.
bex_3.action: set_flag s4_graves_done; give_item spark_drop 2; quest_stage s4_graves 4

bex_wait: Undertaker Bex: Lusk first. Then headstones. I've got the chisel warming.
corin_1_after: Corin: Cistern. Bring coins. I'm told losing is cheaper in bulk.
corin_wait: Corin: Uncle's still solvent. Ruin him first, then we'll talk about my future.

lines: Corin: Before our last duel, a side bet. Stake 500 coins on the town's new water board? Guaranteed returns.
